verdict.rationale: Stripe's own documented export path is report runs (balance, payouts, activity, tax, Revenue Recognition) that "generate downloadable CSV files", an open format, but this covers only financial reports. Nothing in the evidence shows a whole-account export or a documented way to migrate off Stripe, and the subscription-migration doc covers moving data into Stripe, not out. The generic API read access is a building block, not an export feature. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, outbound migration and portability tooling (e.g., customer and payment-method data transfer to another processor), coverage of all object types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
